About this item

  • Soft, Stretchy & Durable Fabric – Made from a premium 88% polyester + 12% spandex blend, this tee feels smooth against the skin with gentle compression that flatters your curves without restriction. Designed for breathability to keep you cool on warmer days, yet durable enough to retain its shape wash after wash. It's machine washable for hassle-free maintenance, and the versatile comfort makes it suitable for daily use – from gym sessions to casual outings and everything in between.
  • A Length That Works in Real Life – This top hits just below the natural waistline, offering coverage without excess fabric. It stays tucked into high-waisted trousers or skirts all day without coming untucked, yet avoids the bulky bunching of standard-length tees. For those who find tops either ride up or hang too low, this length provides a practical solution for both sitting and standing
  • Not See-Through – Just the Right Thickness – The fabric thickness is calibrated to be opaque without feeling heavy. Wear any color bra underneath with confidence, as the material provides full coverage even in lighter shades. This makes the tee versatile for professional settings, casual outings, or any situation where you want a polished look without worrying about what shows through
  • From Work to Weekend – A Versatile Wardrobe Staple – This tee transitions seamlessly across settings. Tuck it into dress pants for a polished office look, or pair with jeans and sneakers for a casual weekend outfit. The clean crew neck, opaque fabric, and true-to-life length suit professional environments while feeling relaxed for daily wear. Quality construction resists pilling and maintains shape
  • Colors From Neutrals to Statement Shades – This tee comes in a wide range of carefully curated colors. Classic essentials: Black, White, Navy, Deep Grey, Light Grey, Beige. Earth tones: Coffee, Chocolate, Army Green, Green, Mauve, Brown. Cool tones: Haze Blue, Light Blue, Royal Blue, Grayish Purple, Purple. Warm & bright: Red, Burgundy, Orange, Yellow, Hot Pink, Light Pink. Each color stays vibrant wash after wash without fading

I fold them up and throw them in my dresser and I am able to just pull them out and use them without having to worry about wrinkles.

    For a fitted shirt I thought for sure that I would have to get an XS but after reading reviews I found that I had to size up and a size S worked out perfectly.

    The only reason I rated this red shirt 4 stars is because it’s a little different than my other ones fit-wise. I ordered a small just like my other ones (and it says small on the inside of the shirt) and it is bigger than my other ones. It is not as fitted and is looser. But its not too big of a difference so I kept it. And I love the color! I would still buy again, but I hope that any other ones I get are the same size as my other ones.

About this Item

  • Soft, Stretchy & Durable Fabric – Made from a premium 88% polyester + 12% spandex blend, this tee feels smooth against the skin with gentle compression that flatters your curves without restriction. Designed for breathability to keep you cool on warmer days, yet durable enough to retain its shape wash after wash. It's machine washable for hassle-free maintenance, and the versatile comfort makes it suitable for daily use – from gym sessions to casual outings and everything in between.
  • A Length That Works in Real Life – This top hits just below the natural waistline, offering coverage without excess fabric. It stays tucked into high-waisted trousers or skirts all day without coming untucked, yet avoids the bulky bunching of standard-length tees. For those who find tops either ride up or hang too low, this length provides a practical solution for both sitting and standing
  • Not See-Through – Just the Right Thickness – The fabric thickness is calibrated to be opaque without feeling heavy. Wear any color bra underneath with confidence, as the material provides full coverage even in lighter shades. This makes the tee versatile for professional settings, casual outings, or any situation where you want a polished look without worrying about what shows through
  • From Work to Weekend – A Versatile Wardrobe Staple – This tee transitions seamlessly across settings. Tuck it into dress pants for a polished office look, or pair with jeans and sneakers for a casual weekend outfit. The clean crew neck, opaque fabric, and true-to-life length suit professional environments while feeling relaxed for daily wear. Quality construction resists pilling and maintains shape
  • Colors From Neutrals to Statement Shades – This tee comes in a wide range of carefully curated colors. Classic essentials: Black, White, Navy, Deep Grey, Light Grey, Beige. Earth tones: Coffee, Chocolate, Army Green, Green, Mauve, Brown. Cool tones: Haze Blue, Light Blue, Royal Blue, Grayish Purple, Purple. Warm & bright: Red, Burgundy, Orange, Yellow, Hot Pink, Light Pink. Each color stays vibrant wash after wash without fading
